2608.19727.title: A Locally Tokenized Generative Model for Robust Time-Series Watermarking
2608.19727.paper_summary: Watermarking is a central tool for provenance in generative models, yet its application to multivariate time series remains hindered by reliability failures under post-editing attacks. We show that existing detectors, which rely on globally coupled re-encoding, suffer from bidirectional drift of the null distribution: post-editing attacks can shift the z-score of non-watermarked samples in either direction, invalidating clean-calibrated thresholds. We argue that this instability is a property of the re-encoding, and that reliable detection requires each recovered unit to depend only on a bounded temporal neighborhood. Guided by this principle, we propose L-VQVAE, a generative model in which each discrete token is produced from a short contiguous window, and LVQMark, a watermarking method over this token space that combines logit-bias injection with robust re-encoding for attack-time detection. Experiments on four benchmarks spanning finance, energy, and neuroimaging show that our approach preserves generation quality while stabilizing both detection power and false-positive behavior under post-editing attacks.
2608.19727.paper_summary_zh: 水印技術是生成模型中追溯來源的核心工具，但其在多變量時間序列中的應用仍然受到後編輯攻擊下可靠性失敗的阻礙。我們展示了現有檢測器依賴於全局耦合的重新編碼，遭受了零分佈的雙向漂移：後編輯攻擊可以在任一方向上改變非水印樣本的z-score，從而使得清晰校準的閾值失效。我們認為這種不穩定性是重新編碼的一個特性，而可靠的檢測要求每個恢復的單位僅依賴於有限的時間鄰域。在這一原則的指導下，我們提出了L-VQVAE，一種生成模型，其中每個離散標記是從一個短的連續窗口中產生的，以及LVQMark，一種在這個標記空間上結合邏輯偏置注入和穩健重新編碼的水印方法，用於攻擊時檢測。在涵蓋金融、能源和神經影像學的四個基準上的實驗顯示，我們的方法在穩定檢測能力和假陽性行為的同時，保持了生成質量。
